name: COBRA2026 public cases (Elekta and Varian)

pairing.xray: 375,618 raw kV projections, a full CBCT sweep a case
pairing.ct: the planning CT, deformably registered, and the CBCT reconstruction
pairing.pose: stored: each case ships its projection geometry
pairing.annotate: masks on each planning CT, L3 to S1 and the pelvis
pairing.pair_key: the case id: a case's projections, CBCT and planning CT share it

what: the 692 public cases of the COBRA2026 challenge, 467 from Elekta and 225 from Varian linacs at six centres: raw kV CBCT projections of supine pelvic radiotherapy patients (375,618 in all), each case with its CBCT reconstruction and the planning CT deformably registered; the held-back cases are cobra_embargoed (Thummerer, Rit, Kamp, Maspero et al.)
level_truth: levels readable from the planning CT; none shipped for the vertebrae

segmentations.masks: none: the release ships no anatomical labels
masks by TotalSegmentator and by SPINEPS on each case's planning CT as the release registers it, the SPINEPS vertebrae named by level in seg/spineps_ctd
segmentations.by: the owner's runs, automatic (TotalSegmentator and SPINEPS); no radiologist has read them

segmentations.masks: vertebra masks of the Varian cases' CTs, each vertebra named by level
segmentations.by: the owner's runs, automatic (SPINEPS); no radiologist has read them

segmentations.masks: vertebra masks by TotalSegmentator and by SPINEPS with VERIDAH, each vertebra named by level, and the level call made from the two together
segmentations.by: the data platform's anomaly harvest, automatic; no radiologist has read them

how_to_get: Held: on the grid at /rs/rs_grp_oschome/go2432/data/cobra2026, fetched from the challenge's Girder archive, every catalogued file at its catalogued size, 2026-09-21 to 2026-09-23; nothing to fetch.
To share it with collaborators, copy it into /rs/rs_grp_oschome/shared/datasets/cobra2026/ with its checksums as a Slurm job, as the pig set of #22 was copied, and note the job in the history.
record: SchwingNet data/sources/cobra_total.json, cobra_elekta.json and cobra_varian.json (one release, counted once here), 2026-10-23
source_status: held on the grid under the owner's data root, as SchwingNet's registry records it on 2026-10-23

history.note: on the grid at /rs/rs_grp_oschome/go2432/data/cobra2026, fetched from the challenge's Girder archive, every catalogued file at its catalogued size, 2026-09-21 to 2026-09-23, before the shared tree and its promoter existed; the record written for the census (#178) from SchwingNet's registry
